message.content:
Wool blend peacoat in midnight blue (#0a1120), structured shoulder cut with a mid-thigh length and woolen texture.
Merino wool pencil skirt in charcoal grey (#36454F), tailored A-line cut hitting just above the knee, heavy knit fabric.
Silk blouse in ivory (#fffff0), relaxed fit with a mandarin collar and long sleeves made of smooth woven silk.
Leather ankle boots in black (#000000), square toe with a 7cm block heel for stability on icy roads, waterproof leather upper.
Silver-tone pendant necklace in oxidized sterling silver (#687385) featuring a simple geometric design to add subtle shine against the dark outer layers.

This outfit works because the midnight blue peacoat and charcoal skirt provide essential protection against the -15°C temperature and snowy conditions while maintaining a professional silhouette suitable for work. The ivory silk blouse offers a necessary visual break from the dark, heavy fabrics without relying on lightness numbers or risking transparency in cold weather. Silver accessories complement her cool-toned skin shades (ranging from #f2dcd6 to #ecd0ca) and echo her hair color (#c3c6cc), creating a cohesive look that respects her refusal of bulky synthetic materials by choosing natural wool and leather. The block heel ensures she can walk safely on salted, icy roads rather than risking injury with stilettos or slipping in flats.
